theorem ProbabilityTheory.extracted_1.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] {s : Set Ω} {x : Ω} (hx : x ∈ s) (hs : s.Finite) (this : {x} ∩ s = {x}) :
  (uniformOn s) {x} = 1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑s) := by
  simp only [uniformOn, cond, Measure.smul_apply, MeasurableSet.singleton, Measure.restrict_apply,
      this, Measure.count_singleton', smul_eq_mul, mul_one, one_div, inv_inj]
    rw [Measure.count_apply_finite _ hs, Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hs]

  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Ω'] [inst_3 : MeasurableSingletonClass Ω'] {s : Set Ω}
  {f : Ω → Ω'} (hmes : Measurable f) (hf : Injective f) {t : Set Ω'} (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hs : s.Infinite) :
  (map f (uniformOn s)) t = (uniformOn (f '' s)) t := by
  simp [uniformOn_of_infinite, hs, hs.image hf.injOn]
